data.name: Strike Protocol
data.detailed_description:
Just Updated

We’ve rolled out a broad improvement pass across visuals, character systems, and core progression. This update focuses on polish, long-term player rewards, and future store functionality.

Reworked Graphical Assets

Visual Upgrade: A wide range of in-game graphical assets have been refreshed and improved to deliver a cleaner, more cohesive look and better overall presentation.

Achievements & Progression System Implemented

Player Progression: In-game achievements and progression systems are now live, allowing you to track milestones and advance through your accomplishments as you play.

Updated Animation & Rigging

Character Improvements: Animations and rigging have been refined for smoother movement and more consistent character behavior across gameplay.

In-Game Store Implementation Started

Store Foundation: Initial work has begun on the new in-game store. Core systems are now being integrated to support future purchasing and reward features.


About the Game

Strike Protocol blends the excitement of dungeon crawling with strategic base building. Choose your role and immerse yourself in a world of modern warfare.
  • Infiltrator Mode: Undertake missions to breach enemy bases, navigate traps, defeat enemies, and earn valuable rewards.
  • Commander Mode: Build and defend your base with intricate layouts, traps, and defending bots to challenge infiltrators.
  • Customization: Equip your character with weapons such as rifles, SMGs, shotguns, and miniguns, each with unique attacks and special abilities.
  • Rewards: Earn weapons, gear, and Credits through successful infiltrations, defenses, daily quests, weekly quests, and special events.
